value.deck: Your AI coding helper, GitHub Copilot, now remembers your project details and can work even without an internet connection in popular coding tools.
shortVersion: Imagine you're building something with LEGOs, and a helpful friend remembers exactly which pieces you like to use and how you usually build things. That's like "Copilot Memory" for your coding assistant. It helps GitHub Copilot remember your project's details and your personal choices, making it smarter over time.

The other new feature is "Ollama support." Think of it like bringing the AI brain right onto your own computer, instead of it living far away on the internet. This means you can use the AI helper even if you're not connected to the internet, or if you want to keep your work extra private.

These new tools are available for people who use GitHub Copilot for their work or business, especially those who use popular coding programs called JetBrains IDEs. They make the AI assistant more useful and flexible for many different ways of working.
value.plainLanguage: GitHub Copilot, an AI helper for coding, now remembers your work better and can run on your own computer, especially for those using JetBrains coding tools.

keyTerms.meaning: An artificial intelligence (AI) assistant that helps computer programmers write code faster by suggesting lines of code.
These are popular computer programs, like fancy word processors for coders, where developers write and test their software.
This feature allows the AI assistant to remember details about your specific project and your personal coding style, even after you close and reopen your work.
A special tool that lets you run AI programs directly on your own computer, which can be useful for privacy or when you don't have internet access.

value.whyItMatters: These updates mean that people who write computer programs can get even more help from their AI assistant. It makes their work faster because the AI remembers what they're doing, and it also allows them to work more privately or without an internet connection, which is important for many businesses.
watchNext: See how these new AI features make coding easier and faster for developers.
Look out for more ways AI tools might remember your preferences in other apps you use.
Keep an eye on how AI can be used directly on your computer for better privacy.
